specDepartures.spec: R4: the row's delivery re-reads the issue and writes nothing when the status moved.
specDepartures.plan: A marked (PersonHandover) row also writes nothing when the re-read issue no longer carries the legion label (D2, T5).
specDepartures.evidence: daemon/outbox.go:508-515 compares statuses alone while the same GetIssue returns HandedOver (dispatch/types.go:117-134); admission treats an unlabelled todo as nobody's (admit/admit.go:198-216), so the daemon would move an issue a person un-labelled.

specDepartures.spec: Design R3: an artifact.approved event whose gate belongs to a root with no live tree is not applied to that gate.
specDepartures.plan: The gate is skipped exactly when R3 queues the root (parked, labelled, primary document, a person's non-carried approval, no live tree), for the root's own gate only; carried copies and a lingering unparked root's gate are applied as today (D3, T4).
specDepartures.evidence: record.TreeLive is false for a lingering root (record/project.go:113-116); R3's trigger needs parked, so a lingering unparked root never queues, and applying its gate as today keeps a reopen inside the linger seeing its approvals; dispatchArtifact loops over carried copies of other roots (workflow/gate.go:536-551).

decisionsForArchitect: D2: delivery of a person's-handover row also requires the label (recommended).
D3: the gate skip is tied to the queue decision, per gate; a lingering unparked root keeps today's behaviour (recommended).
D4: the session-approval exclusion of A3 is proven as Dispatch's 403 plus a daemon unit test (recommended).
D7: the assignee note stays for the controller's own filings, reworded; no new warning for an unassigned root a person labels.
